result: Partial visual validation:24 Linux/WASM captures inspected;21 show the selected body. All six family palettes and stationary/walking bodies are visible in isolated scenes. Two natural Walking Boil frames show only the existing occlusion outline; one native Walking Gut frame is obscured by its explosion. These limits prevent a full combat-readability pass.
limitations: Procedural DeathWard geometry; no Isaac sprite artwork imported.
Small walking feet and pale Sack contrast need broader camera/crowd assessment.
Foreground canyon geometry and the existing opaque explosion effect still obscure bodies in the documented frames.
A static invulnerable player permits contact overlap; it is not a representative player combat evaluation.
Native captures stop exactly at frame140; browser screenshot execution can sample a few later frames. Layout/identity parity is verified, not pixel/animation parity.
Incidental FPS overlays are not controlled performance measurements.
Screenshots alone cannot prove projectile timing, immunity or throw collision; focused native assertions and browser telemetry supply those checks.
